limitations: One sample per scenario; no reliability rate or generalization claimed.
Not native installation/integration validation; actual skill text read from frozen source copies under replay/skill-inputs, hashed before reading.
No independent plan, goal-mainflow or code PASS is issued.
Design is interaction/text artifact only; no screenshot, browser visual validation or real human acceptance.
Acceptance fixture tests are deliberately narrow HTML presence checks; their success is not end-to-end evidence.
Instrumentation is explicit command/file evidence, not a recovered complete host transcript. No Codex sessions files were read.
No user computer, external paid CLI, merge, deployment or persistent permission changes used.
Prior run has loaded-version vs later-copied-version discrepancy; replay independently binds exact frozen input bytes but cannot repair prior run attribution.
